newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks climb in early trade on high-techs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks climb in early trade on high-techs.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Thursday, helped by a boost in high-tech shares such as Sony Corp and a recovery in banking shares, which had been hit hard the previous day.
In the first seven minutes of trade, the 225-share Nikkei average jumped 65.48 points, or 0.36 percent, to 18,251.45. Its March futures rose 60 points to 18,240.

The share price of Sony was up 150 yen at 8,370 yen at 0014 GMT, following its announcement on Wednesday of solid earnings for the October-December quarter and a bright outlook for the current business year.
Brokers said other high-technology issues also climbed, supported by the yen 's weakening against the dollar.

On Wednesday, the electronics giant Sony said its profit would climb to a record high this business year. For the October-December quarter, Sony reported group net profit of 75.38 billion yen ($612 million), up 103 percent, and sales of 1.67 trillion yen ($13.5 billion), up 23.4 percent.
